correctness.rationale: A map is averaging iff it commutes with conjugation by every element of H=〈image A〉. For a fixed C2 subgroup, the four conjugation orbits of the domain yield 2^4−1=15 generating maps, times three such subgroups; for normal C3, 3^4−1=80; for H=S3 full equivariance gives precisely three maps, plus trivial map. Pointed counts fix A(e)=e. Aut(S3)=Inn(S3), orbit-counting uses each C2 subgroup self-normalizing, while on C3 the inversion quotient fixes precisely two of 80 generating maps, giving 41 classes. The three S3-generated maps are singleton orbits. Fresh independent enumeration checked all 6^6=46656 set maps under the defining identity, obtaining 129 accepted, 51 pointed, and 60 total automorphism orbits with orbit-size distribution (6 of size1,39 size2,15 size3).
residual_risks: The general structural criterion does not itself imply arbitrary finite group census; numeric assertions restricted to S3.
